title: 第十一章 她是我雌主第十二章 逃都是疯子
slug: 共梦星际大佬后娇娇夜夜被宠哭
content_zh:
苍珏一身笔挺军装，牵着沈如卿的手，大步流星地走进沈家大厅。
他无视沈家众人惊愕的目光，直接进去拜访，浑身散发着不容置疑的威压。
“沈家主。”
苍珏开门见山，语气冷硬：“本帅今日特来告知，如卿与我两情相悦。
过几日，我会带聘礼正式上门提亲，求娶如卿做我的雌主。”
“什么？雌……雌主？”
沈父震惊得手中的茶杯都差点拿不稳，“哐当”一声掉在桌上。
他怎么也没想到，这个被他视为废棋，准备送给老贵族做续弦的女儿，竟然真的入了元帅的眼！
而且不是普通的正妻，是地位最高的雌主！
这意味着什么？
意味着苍珏不仅要用整个元帅府的资源供养她，甚至容许她日后为了繁衍子嗣，接纳其他的兽夫！
震惊过后，便是狂喜。
这丫头的价值，瞬间翻了百倍不止！
沈父原本冷淡的脸瞬间堆满了谄媚的笑：“这……这是如卿的福气啊！
元帅能看上她，是沈家的荣幸！”
看着沈父这副嘴脸，沈如卿心中冷笑，面上却依旧低眉顺眼。
临走前。
苍珏拿出自己的私人终端，递到沈如卿面前，语气温柔却不容拒绝：“加上我的私人好友，设置特别关注。
有事随时联系我，谁敢欺负你，告诉我。”
沈如卿乖巧地加上了。

做完这一切，苍珏当着沈家众人的面，旁若无人地捧起沈如卿的脸，重重地亲了亲她的嘴角，眼神里满是占有欲。
“等我。”
这才依依不舍地离开。
二楼，阴影处。
沈若冰站在栏杆后，看着这一幕，指甲都要掐断了，掌心渗出了血丝。
她酸溜溜地说了几句恭喜，维持着那副温柔大度的假象。
可一回到房间，她便原形毕露。
“砰！啪！”
昂贵的花瓶被砸得粉碎。
沈若冰面容扭曲，哪里还有半点s级治愈女神的样子？
她怒骂道：“系统！你不是说我是这个世界的女主么？
content_en:
Cang Jue, dressed in a straight military uniform, held Shen Ruqing's hand and strode into the Shen family hall.
He ignored the shocked looks of everyone in the Shen family and went directly in for a visit, exuding unquestionable coercion.
"Master Shen."
Cang Jue got straight to the point and said in a cold tone: "I am here today to tell you that you and I are in love.
In a few days, I will formally come to propose marriage with a betrothal gift, asking you to marry Ruqing and be my mistress. "
"What? Female...female master?"
Father Shen was so shocked that he could barely hold the teacup in his hand, and it fell to the table with a clang.
He never expected that this daughter whom he regarded as useless and was going to be given to the old nobleman as a continuation daughter would actually catch the eye of the marshal!
And she is no ordinary head wife, she is the female protagonist with the highest status!
what does that mean?
This means that Cang Jue will not only use the resources of the entire Marshal's Mansion to support her, but will even allow her to accept other beast husbands in the future in order to reproduce heirs!
After the shock, there was ecstasy.
The value of this girl has more than doubled in an instant!
Father Shen's originally cold face was instantly filled with a flattering smile: "This... this is Ruqing's blessing!
It is an honor for the Shen family that the marshal likes her! "
Seeing Father Shen's face, Shen Ruqing sneered in her heart, but her face remained submissive.
Before leaving.
Cang Jue took out his personal terminal and handed it to Shen Ruqing. His tone was gentle but could not refuse: "Add my personal friends and set up special attention.
Contact me anytime if you have anything. If anyone dares to bully you, tell me. "
Shen Ruqing added obediently.
After doing all this, Cang Jue held up Shen Ruqing's face in front of everyone in the Shen family and kissed her heavily on the corner of the mouth, her eyes full of possessiveness.
"Wait for me."
Then he reluctantly left.
Second floor, in the shadows.
Shen Ruobing stood behind the railing, looking at this scene, her fingernails were about to break, and blood oozed from her palms.
She said a few words of congratulations sourly, maintaining the illusion of gentleness and magnanimity.
But as soon as she returned to the room, her true colors were revealed.
"Bang! Bang!"
Expensive vases were smashed to pieces.
Shen Ruobing's face was distorted. How could she look like an S-level healing goddess?
She cursed angrily: "System! Didn't you say that I am the heroine of this world?
